items.name: portfolio-summary
items.title: Portfolio summary
items.description: Display of a native portfolio valuation's totals: base-currency total, value by entity, the stamped FX collapse policy and degraded positions.
items.docs: Display-only view of the valuation returned by useValuePortfolio (portfolio.valuePortfolio). Shows total_base_currency, the valuation date, fx_collapse_policy as the text Rust stamped, by_entity values in entity registration order (Portfolio#entityIds) and degraded_positions with each risk_error. Amounts are the exact returned money; nothing is summed or converted. Accepts report ({entityIds, valuation}), loading, error and density props; no worker or query provider required.

items.name: positions-table
items.title: Positions table
items.description: Display of each position of a native portfolio valuation in spec order, with the selected position's valuation_result through valuation-summary and measures-grid.
items.docs: Display-only view of the valuation returned by useValuePortfolio. Rows follow Portfolio#positionIds (spec order), never the position_values key order: entity, instrument, native and base values, the FX rate Rust applied, risk completeness and inapplicable_metrics (metrics on the requested menu the instrument has no calculator for). Activating a row shows that position's returned valuation_result with valuation-summary and measures-grid; pass Rust metricMetadata (useMetricMetadata) for measure labels. Accepts report ({positionIds, valuation}), metadata, initialPosition, loading, error and density props; no worker or query provider required.

items.name: portfolio-metrics
items.title: Portfolio metrics
items.description: Display of native aggregated portfolio metrics: a bucketed series chart in Rust order, aggregated totals by entity, raw metrics by position and the unaggregated, skipped and degraded lists.
items.docs: Display-only view of the metrics returned by useValuePortfolio (portfolio.aggregateMetrics) and a series from usePortfolioMetricsSeries (portfolio.portfolioMetricsSeries). The series is charted per first key component (the curve) with buckets in the order Rust returned them, which is lexical (10y, 15y, 1y, ...); no tenor sort is applied while tenor ordering is an open owner decision. Aggregated rows show each total with by-entity columns in entity registration order; the position table shows that position's raw metrics with its native currency. unaggregated_metrics, skipped_metrics and degraded_positions are listed as returned. Accepts report ({positionIds, entityIds, metrics}), series, metadata, initialPosition, formatValue, loading, error and density props; no worker or query provider required.

items.name: scenario-pnl-table
items.title: Portfolio scenario P&L
items.description: Display of native portfolio scenario P&L: positions by scenarios as returned, a total row from each scenario's returned total, a bar chart of the totals and each scenario's report.
items.docs: Display-only view of the batch returned by useScenarioPnlBatch (portfolio.scenarioPnlBatch): rows in Portfolio#positionIds (spec) order, never the by_position key order, plus any position a scenario added in returned key order; one column per scenario in batch order with the exact returned by_position money; a total row from each scenario's returned pnl.total (base currency); a bar chart of those totals; and each scenario's ApplicationReport through market-scenario-report in a disclosure. Nothing is summed or differenced. Accepts report ({positionIds, items}), loading, error and density props; no worker or query provider required.

items.name: use-value-portfolio
items.title: useValuePortfolio
items.description: Values a host-supplied portfolio spec over a market through the WASM worker and aggregates its metrics.
items.docs: portfolio.valuePortfolio over the shared cached Portfolio (Portfolio.fromSpec, keyed on canonical Portfolio#toJson) and MarketContext handles, then portfolio.aggregateMetrics over the same market. Returns {positionIds, entityIds, valuation, metrics}; position and entity ids come from the Portfolio handle in spec and registration order. Omitted metrics and strictRisk stay unset so Rust applies its defaults (PV plus dv01; fail closed). A metric on the menu that an instrument cannot compute is listed on that position's inapplicable_metrics rather than thrown. Each valuation_result keeps 64-bit fields as bigint. Keyed on the complete request and worker session; native errors are returned unchanged. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: use-portfolio-metrics-series
items.title: usePortfolioMetricsSeries
items.description: Decodes one base metric's series from returned portfolio metrics through the WASM worker.
items.docs: portfolio.portfolioMetricsSeries over PortfolioMetrics returned by useValuePortfolio and a canonical base metric id such as bucketed_dv01. Entries ({components, total, by_entity}) arrive in the order Rust returns them, which is lexical by key; no tenor sort is applied. The metrics are plain numbers, so the snapshotted request carries no bigint into the query key. Native errors are returned unchanged. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: use-portfolio-spec-validator
items.title: usePortfolioSpecValidator
items.description: Validates and canonicalizes portfolio spec JSON through the WASM worker, for schema-form.
items.docs: Native PortfolioSpec validation using the existing FinstackProvider worker: portfolio.parsePortfolioSpecJson rejects malformed JSON and schema mismatches, then Portfolio.fromSpec (through the shared handle cache, which keeps the built book for the next valuation) rejects invalid positions, duplicate identifiers and unknown entity references. Returns canonical JSON and rejects superseded revisions.

items.name: use-scenario-pnl-batch
items.title: useScenarioPnlBatch
items.description: Values a host-supplied portfolio under an ordered batch of scenarios through the WASM worker and returns each scenario's native P&L.
items.docs: portfolio.scenarioPnlBatch over the shared cached Portfolio (Portfolio.fromSpec, keyed on canonical Portfolio#toJson) and MarketContext handles; the ScenarioSpec texts are joined into one JSON array and never parsed. Rust values the unshocked base once, then each scenario; it returns one ScenarioPnlBatchItem (scenario_id, pnl with the base-currency total and by_position, report) per scenario in input order, with the book's position ids (Portfolio#positionIds) because integer-like by_position keys enumerate numerically in JavaScript. The batch fails whole with the earliest failing scenario's native error. Keyed on the complete request and worker session. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: use-apply-scenario-and-revalue
items.title: useApplyScenarioAndRevalue
items.description: Applies one scenario to a host-supplied portfolio's market through the WASM worker and returns the native stressed valuation and report.
items.docs: portfolio.applyScenarioAndRevalue over the shared cached Portfolio and MarketContext handles. Returns {positionIds, entityIds, view}: the book's id orders and the native ScenarioRevalueView (the stressed PortfolioValuation, whose valuation_result fields keep 64-bit values as bigint, and the ApplicationReport); present it with portfolio-summary and positions-table. No P&L is computed. Keyed on the complete request and worker session; native errors are returned unchanged. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: portfolio-margin-report
items.title: Portfolio margin report
items.description: Display of a native portfolio margin run: totals, netting sets with their approximation flag, IM collateral by CSA, degraded positions and the selected set's IM breakdown and SIMM sensitivities.
items.docs: Display-only view of the PortfolioMarginResult returned by usePortfolioMargin (portfolio.portfolioMargin): the total margin with an always-shown Indicative badge, every returned total (initial, variation, required and segregated IM collateral, IM transfer) as exact base-currency money, positions_without_margin and total_positions as the counts Rust returns, netting sets in returned order (id, methodology, position count, IM, VM, total and the returned is_approximate flag), IM collateral by CSA in the netting sets' CSA order (then any other returned CSA), degraded positions with Rust's messages, and for the selected netting set its im_breakdown and SIMM sensitivities through simm-sensitivity-table. Amounts are shown as returned, including a -0 variation margin; nothing is summed, netted or converted. Accepts result, loading, error and density props; no worker or query provider required.

items.name: use-portfolio-margin
items.title: usePortfolioMargin
items.description: Calculates a host-supplied portfolio's margin by netting set through the WASM worker.
items.docs: portfolio.portfolioMargin over the shared cached Portfolio (Portfolio.fromSpec, keyed on canonical Portfolio#toJson) and MarketContext handles on the requested date. Positions whose instruments carry a margin_spec form netting sets; the rest count toward positions_without_margin. An omitted currentImCollateral stays unset (Rust treats it as none held); a collateral entry for a CSA the book does not have, or conflicting margin terms within one netting set, return the native validation error. Returns the PortfolioMarginResult as returned. Keyed on the complete request and worker session. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: portfolio-workbench
items.title: Portfolio workbench
items.description: Portfolio workbench: a host-supplied book valued over a host-supplied market, with positions, aggregated risk, scenario P&L, margin and a natively validated book editor.
items.docs: Tabs over the portfolio components, with no native call of its own. Positions: portfolio-summary and positions-table of useValuePortfolio (portfolio.valuePortfolio, then aggregateMetrics) with Rust metricMetadata of every returned measure id. Risk: portfolio-metrics of the same report, charting the usePortfolioMetricsSeries series of seriesBase when one is supplied. Scenarios (only when scenarioJsons are supplied): scenario-pnl-table of useScenarioPnlBatch (portfolio.scenarioPnlBatch). Margin: portfolio-margin-report of usePortfolioMargin (portfolio.portfolioMargin) on asOf with any currentImCollateral. Book: PortfolioSpec JSON that usePortfolioSpecValidator validates natively before every tab values it. The Scenarios and Margin calls run only when their tab first opens. Host-supplied props: defaultSpecJson (PortfolioSpec; remount for a different book), marketJson (MarketContextState), asOf (ISO margin date, never read from the spec), metrics (omitted is Rust's standard set), seriesBase, scenarioJsons (never parsed), currentImCollateral (omitted is none held) and density. Nothing is summed, netted or converted; native errors show as returned. Requires FinstackQueryProvider.
